question.html:
A 50.0 Ω resistor is connected to a cell of emf 3.00 V. The voltmeter and the ammeter in the circuit are ideal.

a

The current in the ammeter is 59.0 mA.

Calculate the internal resistance of the cell.

[2]

b Explain the effect of this change on

b.i the reading of the ammeter. [2]

b.ii the reading of the voltmeter. [2]

c Calculate k. State an appropriate unit for your answer. [3]
